title: Turkish-Style Kuru Fasulye
description: A hearty, comforting Turkish-inspired white bean stew. This dish is a staple of Turkish cuisine, often served with crusty bread or over rice.
instructions: Heat the soya oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dried white beans, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour, or until the beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
